entities.summary: France was represented at the Eurovision Song Contest 2009 with the song "Et s'il fallait le faire", written by Fred Blondin and Anse Lazio, and performed by Patricia Kaas. The French participating broadcaster, France Télévisions, internally selected its entry for the contest. Patricia Kaas was officially announced by France 3 as the French representative on 28 January 2009 and later the song was presented to the public on 1 February 2009.
